thread.title: Apple’s Worth Nearly a $1 Trillion…and It’s Not Expensive

author: Ben Levisohn
title: Apple’s Worth Nearly a $1 Trillion…and It’s Not Expensive
text:
By Ben Levisohn Aug. 2, 2018 11:43 a.m. ET Shares of Apple (AAPL) continue to rally today, and are less than 20 cents away from a $1 trillion valuation.
Illustration: Eleven X Apple has gained 2.7% to $206.89 at 11:36 p.m., giving it a market valuation of $999 billion and change. The magic trillion-dollar number for the stock is $207.05.
Apple has gained more than 20% so far this year--and 8.8% during the first two days of August--but still doesn't look expensive. It trades at 17.6 times 12 month forward earnings forecasts, just a touch higher than the S&P 500's 17.5 times.
